description.value: The TON_IoT datasets are new generations of Industry 4.0/Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial IoT (IIoT) datasets for evaluating the fidelity and efficiency of different cybersecurity applications based on Artificial Intelligence (AI), i.e., Machine/Deep Learning algorithms. The datasets can be downloaded from HERE . You can also use our dataset, the UNSW-NB15 .

limitations: The official UNSW SharePoint folder was retried without credentials and returned HTTP 403; authentication was not bypassed. Verified UNSW-NB15 train/test files are recorded separately.
